pharmacology.text: Amezinium metilsulfate has a unique mechanism of action of acting as a dual monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (NRI).

summary.en: Amezinium, usually supplied as amezinium metilsulfate, is a drug used to raise blood pressure. It works on the noradrenaline system rather than acting as a classic stimulant, and it has been used mainly in Japan and parts of Europe.
summary.zh: Amezinium 通常以甲磺酸鹽形式供應，是一種用來升高血壓的藥物。它作用於正腎上腺素系統，而非作為典型興奮劑，主要在日本與歐洲部分地區使用。
summary.zhHans: Amezinium 通常以甲磺酸盐形式供应，是一种用来升高血压的药物。它作用于正肾上腺素系统，而非作为典型兴奋剂，主要在日本与欧洲部分地区使用。

uses.en: It is used to treat low blood pressure, including the drop in blood pressure on standing up that can cause dizziness and fainting.
uses.zh: 它用於治療低血壓，包括起身時血壓下降而造成頭暈與昏倒的情況。
uses.zhHans: 它用于治疗低血压，包括起身时血压下降而造成头晕与昏倒的情况。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include headache, palpitations, a raised blood pressure and trembling. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor it can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure, so people taking it are warned about aged cheeses and other tyramine-rich foods.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括頭痛、心悸、血壓升高與顫抖。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，它可能造成血壓危險升高，因此服用者會被告知留意陳年乳酪等富含酪胺的食物。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括头痛、心悸、血压升高与颤抖。作为单胺氧化酶抑制剂，它可能造成血压危险升高，因此服用者会被告知留意陈年奶酪等富含酪胺的食物。

fact.en: It is unusual in combining two actions in one molecule: it blocks the enzyme that breaks noradrenaline down and also blocks its reuptake, so noradrenaline builds up where it is released.
fact.zh: 它不尋常之處在於一個分子兼具兩種作用：它既阻斷分解正腎上腺素的酵素，也阻斷其回收，使正腎上腺素在釋放處累積。
fact.zhHans: 它不寻常之处在于一个分子兼具两种作用：它既阻断分解正肾上腺素的酵素，也阻断其回收，使正肾上腺素在释放处累积。
